data.title: 克洛伊 · 厨房里的星星饭团
data.description: 克洛伊穿橙色格纹衬衫和藏蓝围裙，坐在矮桌前将饭团模具轻轻倒扣。星形饭团完好落在盘中，她得意地扬起眉毛，双手停在盘边像是在展示自己的小小杰作。
data.action: 倒扣出完整星形饭团，得意地把双手停在盘边。
data.promptProse: Chloe turns the star-shaped rice mold onto its plate, waits for the rice ball to emerge intact and sets both hands beside it with a triumphant grin. Her orange checked long-sleeved shirt, cream trousers and navy apron remain practical and fully covered. In the seated medium view, the low worktable fills the near edge; the higher kitchen counter extends behind her shoulder, with a closed cabinet below it to establish the room’s scale. Clear morning daylight reveals her warm brown skin and orange eyes. The finished rice ball casts a small star-shaped shadow, and the plate leaves a broader soft contact shadow on the wood.
